newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: ABC says won't pay dividend for 1996.
newsitem.headline: ABC says won't pay dividend for 1996.

text.p: Arab Banking Corp (ABC) said on Monday it would not pay a dividend to shareholders for 1996 for the second year running.

A bank statement said ABC shareholders on Monday approved a board of directors' recommendation to strengthen the group's capital resources to meet "impending challenges for the global banking industry." It did not elaborate.
The Bahrain-based bank, one of largest banks in the Arab world, posted a $129 million net profit in 1996, up from $116 million in 1995.
ABC said the decision not to pay a dividend had increased shareholders' funds by eight percent to $1.657 billion at end-1996 from $1,540 billion at end-1995.
